Joyce Center]] |champion= [[2017 Maui Invitational Tournament|Maui Invitational]] champions |tourney= [[2018 National Invitation Tournament|NIT]] |tourney_result = Second Round }} {{2017–18 ACC men's basketball standings}} The '''2017–18 Notre Dame Fighting Irish men's basketball team''' represented the [[University of Notre Dame]] during the [[2017–18 NCAA Division I men's basketball season]]. The Fighting Irish, led by 18th-year head coach [[Mike Brey]], played their home games at [[Edmund P. Joyce Center]] in [[South Bend, Indiana]] as fifth-year members of the [[Atlantic Coast Conference]]. They finished the season 21–15, 8–10 in [[2017–18 Atlantic Coast Conference men's basketball season|ACC play]] to finish tied with [[2017-18 Syracuse Orange men's basketball team|Syracuse]] for tenth place. As the No. 10 seed in the [[2018 ACC men's basketball tournament|ACC tournament]], they defeated [[2017–18 Pittsburgh Panthers men's basketball team|Pittsburgh]] in the first round and [[2017–18 Virginia Tech Hokies men's basketball team|Virginia Tech]] in the second round before losing to [[2017–18 Duke Blue Devils men's basketball team|Duke]] in the quarterfinals. They were one of the last four teams not selected for the [[2018 NCAA Division I men's basketball tournament|NCAA tournament]] and as a result earned a No. 1 seed in the [[2018 National Invitation Tournament|National Invitation Tournament]], where they defeated [[2017–18 Hampton Pirates men's basketball team|Hampton]] in the first round before losing to [[2017–18 Penn State Nittany Lions basketball team|Penn State]] in the second round. ==Previous season== The [[2016–17 Notre Dame Fighting Irish men's basketball team|Fighting Irish]] finished the [[2016–17 NCAA Division I men's basketball season|2016–17 season]] 26–10, 12–6 in [[2016–17 Atlantic Coast Conference men's basketball season|ACC play]] to finish in a three-way tie for second place. They defeated [[2016–17 Virginia Cavaliers men's basketball team|Virginia]] and [[2016–17 Florida State Seminoles men's basketball team|Florida State]] to advance to the championship game of the [[2017 ACC men's basketball tournament|ACC tournament]] where they lost to [[2016–17 Duke Blue Devils men's basketball team|Duke]]. They received an at-large bid to the [[2017 NCAA Division I men's basketball tournament|NCAA tournament]] as the No. 5 seed in the West Region. There they defeated #12 seed [[2016–17 Princeton Tigers men's basketball team|Princeton]] in the First Round before losing in the Second Round where they lost to #4 seed [[2016–17 West Virginia Mountaineers men's basketball team|West Virginia]]. ==Offseason== ===Departures=== {| class="wikitable sortable" border="1" !
